ios.desc:
Quran Unlock blocks your distracting apps until you have read Quran. Join 300,000+ Muslims building better habits through faith.

Struggling to read Quran consistently? You are not alone. Social media, games, and endless scrolling steal our time. Quran Unlock flips the script: your apps stay locked until you prioritize what truly matters.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Choose the apps that distract you most: Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, or whatever pulls you in.
2. Pick your prayer times: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha.
3. After each prayer, your apps stay locked until you have read 5 minutes of Quran.
4. Read. Listen. Reflect. Your apps unlock automatically.

No willpower battles. No guilt loops. Just a gentle nudge that turns every prayer into a moment of remembrance.

INSIDE THE APP

Reels Mode: TikTok-style vertical verse feed with word-by-word recitation highlighting. Swipe through ayahs, listen to the Quran like never before.

Mushaf Reader: full 604-page canonical layout, tap any verse to hear it recited by Mishary, Husary, Alafasy and more.

Per-Prayer Goals: each prayer is its own commitment. Complete Fajr's 5 min and your apps unlock until Dhuhr starts. Then a fresh window opens with the same threshold and a new opportunity.

15 Languages: Arabic, English, French, Urdu, Indonesian, Turkish, Spanish, Malay, Farsi, Russian, Hindi, Bengali, Italian, Portuguese, German. Translation, transliteration, recitation: all in your language.

Streak Tracking: see your daily progress, unlock badges, build a habit that lasts.

Custom Rules: set your own challenges. Block Twitter until I finish Surah Al-Mulk. No social media until I read 10 ayahs of Al-Baqarah. Your goals, your rules.

Friday Al-Kahf: automatically armed every Friday.

Daily Azkar: morning and evening remembrances integrated into your routine.

WHY IT WORKS

We do not preach. We do not shame. We use the same psychology that makes social media addictive, but in reverse. By placing 5 minutes of Quran between you and Instagram, every reach for your phone becomes a chance for dhikr.

Whether you are starting your journey or rebuilding consistency after years away, Quran Unlock meets you where you are. Some users start with 1 prayer per day. Others lock all five. Your pace, your path.

PRIVACY FIRST

We use Apple's Screen Time framework to lock your apps locally on your device. We do not see what apps you use. We do not track your reading. Your spiritual journey is between you and Allah.

No ads. No data selli

android.desc:
📖 Read Quran First to Unlock Your Apps

Struggling to stay consistent with your daily Quran reading? Quran Unlock helps you build a lasting habit by gently blocking distracting apps until you complete your daily recitation.

🔒 How It Works

1. Set your daily Quran reading goal (pages or minutes)
2. Choose which apps to block (Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, etc.)
3. When you try to open blocked apps, Quran Unlock reminds you to read first
4. Complete your session to unlock your apps for the day

✨ Features

- Smart App Blocking - Temporarily blocks distracting social media apps until you finish your daily Quran reading

- Flexible Goals - Set goals based on pages read or time spent (Juz, half Juz, or custom)

- Streak Tracking - Build momentum with daily streaks and never break the chain

- Beautiful Badges - Earn achievement badges as you progress (7-day, 30-day, 100-day streaks and more)

- Session History - Track your reading sessions and see your progress over time

- Smart Reminders - Get gentle notifications to help you stay on track

- Clean, Islamic Design - Beautiful interface with calming green gradients and thoughtful Islamic aesthetics

🎯 Why Quran Unlock?

We built Quran Unlock because we understand the struggle. In a world of endless scrolling and notifications, it's easy to delay our most important spiritual commitment. Quran Unlock doesn't judge or shame - it simply creates a gentle barrier between you and distractions, making it easier to prioritize what matters most.

💚 For Every Muslim

Whether you're trying to complete the Quran during Ramadan, maintain consistency throughout the year, or simply want to strengthen your relationship with Allah's word, Quran Unlock is your accountability partner.

🔐 Privacy First

- No data collection from your Quran reading
- App usage stays on your device
- No ads, no tracking
- Your spiritual journey is private

🚀 Join Thousands of Muslims

Quran Unlock has already helped thousands of Muslims worldwide build consistent Quran reading habits. Start your journey today and transform how you connect with the Quran.

"The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it." - Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

📧 Need Help?

Contact us at kalycodes@gmail.com

Note: Quran Unlock requires Android accessibility permissions to function properly. These permissions are used solely to detect when blocked apps are opened and to help you stay focused on your Quran reading goal.

quotes.text:
Hey HN,
I'm a solo developer from Nigeria. I built Quran Unlock - an app that blocks distracting apps (TikTok, Instagram, etc.) until you complete your daily Quran reading.

The idea came from my own struggle with phone addiction. I wanted to read Quran daily but kept getting distracted. So I built this for myself, then shared it.

Some stats after 2 months: - 123K+ users - 64.9% returning user rate - 31M events tracked

Tech stack: - React Native - Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Analytics, Cloud Messaging) - RevenueCat for subscriptions - iOS Screen Time API + Android UsageStats

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/quran-unlock/id6754449406

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.app.quranunlock&hl=en

Would love feedback from the HN community!
